name: Naturalización por Residencia (Ley 1155)

requirement_groups.name: Central American, Spanish, or Ibero-American nationals

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 5 years of official residence in Costa Rica.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years' official residence in Costa Rica.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires passing the Ministry of Public Education's Spanish-language and Social Studies naturalisation exams (or recognised equivalent studies), unless exempt (elderly applicants, or permanent health/cognitive conditions with medical certification).
requirements.fix_path: Book and pass the Spanish/Social Studies naturalisation exams.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 7 years of official residence in Costa Rica.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 7 years' official residence in Costa Rica.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires passing the Ministry of Public Education's Spanish-language and Social Studies naturalisation exams (or recognised equivalent studies), unless exempt (elderly applicants, or permanent health/cognitive conditions with medical certification).
requirements.fix_path: Book and pass the Spanish/Social Studies naturalisation exams.

evidence_required.document: Written petition, valid ID, apostilled/translated birth certificate
Two sworn witness statements (residency, means of support, good conduct)
Police/judicial clearance certificate (issued within 3 months), apostilled/translated
Pass on Ministry of Public Education Spanish and Social Studies naturalisation exams (or recognised equivalent studies)

sources.title: Tribunal Supremo de Elecciones (tse.go.cr) -- Naturalización por Residencia, Ley 1155

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Costa Rica's initial build. Both groups additionally require passing the Ministry of Public Education's Spanish-language and Social Studies naturalisation exams (or recognised equivalent prior studies), with exemptions for elderly applicants and those with permanent health/cognitive conditions (medical-certificate-documented) -- the exam requirement is listed under evidence_required rather than duplicated as a separate hard requirement per group, to avoid redundancy, but is fully part of the qualifying test for both nationality groups. dual_citizenship_allowed set true: Costa Rica generally permits dual citizenship (naturalising does not require renouncing prior citizenship), consistent with common knowledge and not contradicted by the source. Processing time: 285 business days; the service itself is free (a fiscal stamp fee of 20 or 200 colones applies depending on nationality).
